title: Segments
name: Segment name
emptyList: A segment is a saved question about your contacts, for example „who opened nothing in half a year". Start from a ready made one, or build your own.
notNullHint: Contacts that do not have this field at all are not included. Use the „is empty" condition.
addEmptyCondition: Also add contacts with the field left empty

quantifier.any: at least one of these conditions

builder.quantifierLabel: all of the conditions, or at least one

negationHint.andNot: Contacts get in when at least one condition below is false for them.
negationHint.orNot: Contacts get in only when every condition below is false for them.

builder.noDeeper: This is as deep as the nesting goes.
builder.splitSuggestion: This segment is complex. Would you like to split it in two?
builder.listLimit: A list holds at most {limit} items.
builder.noOptions: Nothing to choose from yet. Create a tag or a list first.

fields.unindexed: Searching by this field is slower. On a large database the calculation can take longer.

operatorHints.is_member: Including those who have not confirmed the subscription yet.
operatorHints.is_missing: People whose consent we have no record of.
operatorHints.is_withdrawn: People who actively took their consent back. Legally this is not the same as „never gave it".

count.exact: The segment holds {count, plural, =0 {nobody} one {# contact} few {# contacts} many {# contacts} other {# contacts}}
count.failed: The count could not be calculated.
count.emptyAll: The segment has no condition yet, so it holds every contact ({count, number}).
count.failedDetail: The count could not be calculated. Technical detail: {detail}

warnings.segment_count_estimated: The number is an estimate, an exact calculation would take too long.
warnings.segment_unindexed_field: The condition on {field} is slow to calculate, because the database has no index for it. On a large database this can take longer.
warnings.segment_slow_engagement: Conditions on campaign activity search through the history of every message sent. On a large database expect a few seconds.
warnings.segment_archived_field: The field {field} is archived and new contacts no longer fill it in.

traps.noCampaignsYet: You have not sent a campaign yet, so every single contact matches this condition.
traps.contradiction: Nobody can match {a} and {b} at the same time. Did you mean to switch the top to „at least one of these conditions"?
traps.rarelyFilled: The field {field} is filled in for only {filled, number} contacts out of {total, number}.
traps.containsUnsubscribed: Out of {total} contacts, {count} are unsubscribed and the campaign will not reach them.
traps.containsRestricted: Out of {total} contacts, {count} have restricted processing under GDPR and the campaign will not reach them.
traps.cycle: Segment {a} points at segment {b} and that one points back at {a}. This cannot be calculated.

empty.title: The segment holds nobody
empty.mostRestrictive: This condition narrows it the most:
empty.others: The other conditions on their own:
empty.fieldStats: The field {field} is filled in for only {filled, number} contacts out of {total, number}. Most frequent values: {values}
empty.includeEmpty: Do you want to include contacts with the field left empty?

limits.tooComplex: The segment already has {limit} conditions, which is the maximum. Split it in two and join them with the „is in the segment" condition.
limits.tooManyEngagement: There can be at most {limit} conditions on campaign activity, because each of them searches the history of messages sent.
limits.tooManyEvent: There can be at most {limit} conditions on behaviour on the website.
limits.listTooLong: A list holds at most {limit} items. We dropped {dropped}.
limits.nestingTooDeep: Pointing at a segment that points at another segment works to the second level at most.

presets.sectionTitle: Start from a ready made one

neverOpened.title: Never opened
neverOpened.explanation: They received at least 3 emails and opened none.

neverClicked.title: Never clicked
neverClicked.explanation: They received at least 5 emails and clicked in none.

inactive90d.title: Inactive for 90+ days
inactive90d.explanation: They did nothing in the last 3 months and we have had them for longer than 3 months.

noOpenLastN.title: Opened none of the last 5 campaigns
noOpenLastN.explanation: They received the last 5 campaigns and opened none.

unconfirmed30d.title: Subscription unconfirmed for over 30 days
unconfirmed30d.explanation: They signed up but never confirmed the link in the email.

repeatedSoftBounces.title: Repeated soft bounces
repeatedSoftBounces.explanation: Their email failed to arrive temporarily at least 3 times.

presets.useBody: This creates your own segment with that condition. Later changes to the ready-made one will not affect it.
presets.useFailed: The segment could not be created. Technical detail: {detail}

freeze.explanation: We freeze the list so it does not change during the campaign. Anyone who gets in touch meanwhile drops out of the cleanup.

cleanup.title: What do we do with those who stay silent?
cleanup.unsubscribeHint: They stay in the database, but we stop sending them campaigns.
cleanup.tagOnlyHint: Nothing changes, we just put them aside for later.
cleanup.deleteHint: Irreversibly. Only the project owner can do this.
cleanup.countdown: In {days, plural, =0 {today} one {# day} few {# days} many {# days} other {# days}} we decide about {count} contacts.
cleanup.warning: In {days} days we will unsubscribe {count} contacts.
cleanup.confirmTitle: In {days, plural, =0 {today} one {# day} few {# days} many {# days} other {# days}} we will unsubscribe {count} contacts
cleanup.confirmBody: The reactivation campaign {campaign} went out on {sentAt} to {sent} people. So far {responded} got in touch. We will unsubscribe the remaining {count} on {when}. Unsubscribing cannot be taken back. Anyone who wants to return has to sign up again themselves.
cleanup.typeName: Type the segment name to confirm

audience.title: Campaign audience

gates.snoozed: communication paused at their own request

audience.willSend: The campaign will go out to {count, plural, =0 {nobody} one {# person} few {# people} many {# people} other {# people}}

fromCampaign.prefilledNotice: We prefilled the condition from the campaign report. Check it, adjust it if you like, and save.
fromCampaign.notOpenedNotice: People who clicked in the campaign are not counted as non-openers: a click proves they saw the message, which is why the report counts it as an open.

fieldScopes.lastCampaigns: ({count, plural, =0 {no campaigns} one {last campaign} other {last # campaigns}})
fieldScopes.sinceDays: (in the last {days, plural, =0 {day} one {# day} other {# days}})
